title: Being able to drag window previews to reorganize their order
line: You can now drag a window's preview in a grouped task's tooltip to change the order of the group's windows.
explanation: Nothing was broken: the entries of a group tooltip only reacted to clicks and hover, so dragging a thumbnail did nothing, and the only way to change the order of a group's windows (which is also the order clicking the task cycles through) was the textual group popup. The task model already supports moving a window inside its group in manual sort mode. The change adds a DragHandler to each tooltip entry (the thumbnail, or the title row when thumbnails are off) that, while dragging, moves the dragged window onto the entry under the pointer with tasksModel.move(), so the list reorders live; the list is made non-interactive during the drag so it doesn't take the drag over as a flick.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: reorder grouped windows by dragging their previews

There was no way to change the order of a group's windows in its tooltip,
which is also the order clicking the task cycles through. With manual
sorting, dragging a window preview (or its title) now moves that window.

BUG: 508968

media.caption: Master: Window3's preview is held and dragged onto Window1, nothing moves (order stays 1/2/3).
Fix: dragging Window2's preview to the left moves it to the front while dragging (2/1/3).
Master: drag the last preview to the left, release, reopen the tooltip: same order.
Fix: the dragged window moves to the front, the order stays when the tooltip is reopened, and a plain click still activates a window.
